OPENING LINE
Discover Southern Vermont with Adam Palmiter – Your Trusted Local Expert
Try another opening line
YOUR INTRODUCTION
Adam Palmiter has been a leading presence in Southern Vermont real estate since 2004, combining deep local roots with a commitment to exceptional service. Known for his insight into Mount Snow and Deerfield Valley, Adam works with buyers and sellers alike, specializing in a range of properties from trailside condos to luxury estates. His hands-on approach, rapid communication, and market expertise have made him the go-to agent for those seeking both a seamless transaction and a personal touch. As a year-round resident and active community member, Adam brings genuine passion for helping others discover the lifestyle that makes Vermont so unique.
